title: Progressive Blur
description: Layered backdrop blurs that deepen toward an edge, to fade scrolling content out at the top, the bottom or both.
docs:
Installed `ProgressiveBlur`. Import it from `@/components/ui/progressive-blur` and place it inside a `relative` container, next to (not inside) the scrolling element: `<ProgressiveBlur position="bottom" height="40%" />`.

It stacks eight `backdrop-filter` layers, each masked to a band, so the blur grows smoothly toward the edge. It is decorative and ignores the pointer.

Ported from magicuidesign/magicui (MIT, copyright Magic UI); the license text is in the file.

props.name: position
props.description: Which edge the blur deepens toward (both covers the whole container).

props.name: height
props.description: The blurred band's height (ignored for both).

props.name: blurLevels
props.description: Blur radius per layer, in px, from the inner edge outward.

a11y: Decorative: aria-hidden, pointer-events none; the content under it stays readable and scrollable.
Static: no motion. Put it beside a scroll container that is keyboard reachable (the demo's has tabindex=0 and a name).
